scope: Selected goal task page generated design preview with direct task addition
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: One complete high-fidelity iPhone screen design preview for 粥记, the task page INSIDE a selected goal.
Primary request: Design the page the user sees immediately after tapping the goal "多读书". On THIS page, the user can see this goal's tasks and directly add a new task under this goal. Make the task addition area unmistakable and practical.
Input images: Image 1 is the individual-goal settings screen, an exact style reference. Image 2 is the goal-detail concept, also a style and mascot identity reference. Use their SAME rounded handwritten Chinese title style, ivory fibrous paper, olive and terracotta palette, ink grain, thin sand borders, and the same cute durian. The requested page is the goal TASK page, not the goal configuration form.
Composition: One edge-to-edge portrait iPhone screen, approximately 9:19.5 aspect ratio. No phone bezel, no external poster, no collage. 9:41 status bar, standard dark status symbols and bottom home indicator.
Style: Vintage silkscreen poster printing plus hand-drawn flat illustration. Warm cream fibrous paper, fine scattered print speckles, dry matte spot-color ink, irregular tiny ink holes inside illustration fills, slightly imperfect handmade outlines. Forest and moss green, buttery yellow, warm deep brown, terracotta orange. All Chinese text is clean and crisp, fixed labels naturally handwritten, input content in a simple readable body font. No 3D, gradients, gloss, glow or dark mode.
Layout from top to bottom:
Small olive back chevron on the upper left; upper-right small olive sliders icon plus the small exact label "设置" as the entry to this goal's configuration page.
Large dark forest handwritten title "多读书". A modest same-brand durian illustration on the right of the header reading an open green book: olive spiky shell, short brown stem, broad buttery-yellow face, tiny black dot eyes, smiling mouth, peach cheeks, cream hands, thick warm-brown uneven outline. Keep header compact so the task list and addition area have ample room.
A compact ivory rounded progress card: left exact label "已完成 3/5", right "60%"; below a simple olive horizontal bar filled to exactly 60%, rest sandy cream. It is a progress display, not a slider.
Section heading "目标任务". One quietly rounded ivory card with five compact task rows separated by thin sandy lines. Left circular completion checkboxes, titles aligned neatly, small right play triangle only for pending tasks. Exactly:
empty circle, "读第三章", small olive play triangle;
empty circle, "整理读书笔记", small olive play triangle;
olive filled checked circle, "选好一本书", muted with subtle strikethrough;
olive filled checked circle, "读第一章", muted with subtle strikethrough;
olive filled checked circle, "读第二章", muted with subtle strikethrough.
Exactly three completed tasks out of five; pending tasks at top. No more task rows.
Below the task list, an unmistakable separate compact addition card, visible on the same screen above the tab bar. Section label "添加任务". Under it a single inset rounded text field showing an example draft task name "读十页书", with a small clear × at the far right. No keyboard is shown; this is the overview with a prepared draft.
Directly below the field, small muted text exactly "新任务会自动归属「多读书」".
Then one broad terracotta rounded button with a small ivory plus and exact ivory text "添加任务". The button belongs to this addition card and is large enough to tap. After tapping it, the new task appears in THIS goal's list. The draft is not yet part of the five listed tasks and not counted in the progress.
Make the addition card clearly distinct from the existing task list, but part of the same page. Consistent left/right margins and corner radii; comfortable spacing; list and adding a task remain the focus. Avoid oversized illustration or large empty spacer.
Fixed cream bottom tab bar with four matching hand-drawn icons and labels in order: "今天", "目标", "日历", "我的". Second target icon and label selected terracotta, others muted olive. Keep action and input fully above the tab bar, none obscured.
Constraints: A single goal name, five existing tasks, a single task-name input, and one add action. No goal-name editing or icon-selection grid on this screen. No dropdown for goal assignment, because all additions here automatically belong to "多读书". No deadline, reminder, priorities, notes, schedule, KPI, manual progress adjustment, backup, extra page panels or extra slogan. All exact Chinese text accurate and readable. Output one finished goal task page.
visual_review: Five existing task rows include three completed and two pending, consistent with 3/5 and 60%. A separate task-name draft field and explicit add button are visible, with current-goal ownership helper. Settings entry, printed mascot, cream paper, typography and bottom tabs match the preceding concepts.
